newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan 100-share index rises above 1,900 points.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan 100-share index rises above 1,900 points.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share price index rose above the 1,900-point psychological barrier in early Monday trade on buying of Pakistan Telecom and ICI Pakistan stocks by foreign fund managers.
The index surged 56 points in 25 minutes of trade at 10.25 a.m. (0525 GMT) amid huge buying by foreigners, dealer Ali Raza Mooney said.
Pakistan Telecom jumped 2.80 rupees to 41.15 and ICI Pakistan 2.80 to 33.20 soon after the opening of the market.
The market opened after the Friday's religious holiday and the Saturday and Sunday weekend.
